name: Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken Noodles
subtitle: Crispy ground chicken in a sticky honey, garlic, chili and black vinegar glaze, tossed with noodles and seared cabbage slaw

macros.portion: About 2½ cups: 1¼ cups noodles, ~4½ oz cooked chicken, and ¾ cup seared slaw.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number. Assumes ground chicken breast; regular ground chicken (about 93% lean) adds ~80 kcal and lowers protein a few grams per portion.

before: **2 lb ground chicken breast** thawed in the fridge, if frozen.
notes: Sear the slaw in two batches so it browns instead of steaming. Leave the chicken alone at first so it forms a golden crust, and stir sparingly once the sauce goes in so it reduces to a sticky glaze. Chinese black vinegar gives a malty, smoky tang. Balsamic works but tastes sweeter and fruitier.

items: 12 oz dried wheat noodles (knife-cut, lo mein or udon; 340 g)

steps.title: Water on
steps.body: Large pot of unsalted water, covered, over high heat.

steps.title: Prep while it heats
steps.body: In a bowl, whisk the sauce: **5 Tbsp honey + 3 Tbsp chili garlic sauce + 3 Tbsp low-sodium soy sauce + 3 Tbsp black vinegar + ⅓ cup water**, plus **1 Tbsp grated ginger** and **6 cloves garlic**, minced. Taste it: sweet, tangy and hot, saltier than you'd eat alone but not harsh. If it's harsh, add **1–2 Tbsp water**. Slice the greens of **5 scallions**.

steps.title: Sear the slaw
steps.body: Skillet over medium-high with **1 tsp olive oil**. Add half the **coleslaw mix** and cook **3–4 min**, tossing occasionally, until browned in spots but still crisp-tender. Move to a bowl. Repeat with **1 tsp olive oil** and the rest of the slaw.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.body: Same skillet over medium-high with **1 tsp olive oil**. Press **2 lb ground chicken** into an even layer and leave it **3 min** to brown. Flip in sections, cook **2–3 min** more, then break it into bite-size pieces.

steps.title: Noodles in
steps.body: Add **12 oz noodles** to the boiling water and set a timer for the package time.

steps.title: Glaze the chicken
steps.body: Pour the sauce over the chicken. Cook **3–4 min**, stirring only occasionally, until the liquid reduces to a sticky glaze and the chicken is cooked through (165°F).

steps.title: Drain and toss
steps.body: Scoop out **½ cup noodle water**, then drain the noodles and return them to the pot. Add the chicken, slaw and **1 tsp toasted sesame oil**, and toss, adding noodle water a spoonful at a time until everything is glossy. Top with the scallion greens and **1 Tbsp sesame seeds**.

after: Pack 3 lunches. Add **1 Tbsp water** per container before microwaving; the noodles soak up the glaze overnight.
Doesn't freeze well; the slaw goes limp.

source.label: Adapted from masonfit's Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken Noodles
